notes: Model = ideal-drag physical model copied from make_model_param_heatmaps.py (identical arithmetic).
'lsq71' = same LSQ (a0 + cos/sin l + cos/sin 2l) at the 71 data longitudes as the data fit; 'fine' = exact Fourier series of the model on its 181-point full-circle grid.
Phases: l1 = direction of dipole maximum; l2 = quadrupole maximum (mod 180).
71 points come from overlapping 90-deg sectors stepped by 5 deg: not independent.

octupole_fit.note: axisymmetric model predicts l3 = l0 + 60 (mod 120) when its m=3 coefficient is negative

analytic_expansion.formula: Q2 = T2*kappa*cos^2(b0)*g1/2/N ; D1 = T1*kappa*(d/D)*[1.5 cos b0 g1 + 0.375 cos^3 b0 (g2-g1)]/N ; g1 = D f'(D)/kappa, g2 = D^2 f''(D)/kappa, f = u_pec/r ; D1<0 means dipole max at l0+180
